# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple and WinUI servicing fixes**

## Highlights

Backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and a WinUI .NET 9 packaging fix to the 3.119.x line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library TFMs backported** — Backports the 26.0 library target and unversioned app TFM support so 3.119.x consumers can build against the newer Apple SDKs. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9** — Fixes a packaging issue where the WinUI Projection DLL could not be found by .NET 9 consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
